events.name: African Insurance Company: officers listed in the 1811 Philadelphia directory
events.description: The Philadelphia Directory for 1811 (p. 416) lists the company among the city's insurance companies: office No. 159 Lombard Street, capital 5,000 dollars, shares 50 dollars, President Joseph Randolph, Treasurer Cyrus Porter, Secretary William Coleman. It adds, 'The members of this company are all coloured persons.' The same directory's list of coloured persons gives Joseph Randolph, confectioner, 162 S. Fifth; Cyrus Porter, stablekeeper, 159 Lombard (the company's office address); and William Coleman, teacher, 155 Lombard.
